title: My Dream Is to Be the World's Number One Mascot

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to the exhibition meet she mentioned yesterday. Just like during the previous mock race, many Trainers had gathered to see Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's running today too, huh?
...That girl's always smiling, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan wore the exact same smile as always—one so natural that anyone unaware of yesterday's events wouldn't suspect a thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Why did she invite me to today's exhibition meet?
No matter how much I pondered, I couldn't figure out the reason.
choice_data_list: (Will I understand once I watch, or does she just want me to see?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without an answer in sight, the race soon got underway.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: —Aston Machan breaks out cleanly with a brilliant dash!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *pant, huff, haah*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan was composed.
She read the flow of the race, waiting for the decisive moment. And then—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Now entering the final stretch! Aston Machan is running in third!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her distinctive pitch stride tore into the turf.
With every blink of an eye, she accelerated further.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan closing in on the outside!
Here comes Aston Machan on the outside, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Catching the leader, blowing right past them, and accelerating once more. And then—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sight of Aston Machan surging past the winning post was so powerful, so vivid, so breathtakingly fleeting—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "—The most important thing is a trace. A trace that does not vanish even after one is gone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I realized it, I was overcome by an intense urge: I must never take my eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, huff, wheeze*... Phew~...
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent victory with a five-length lead!
And what's more... Aston Machan has set a new course record!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on... Huh?! She threw a shoe?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(chatter, murmuring...)*

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: S-Seriously...?! Throwing a shoe and still clocking that kind of speed...?! That girl is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before my brain could register it, my body had already moved. I broke into a run, leaving the stands behind—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's an incredible talent! I'm definitely going to try scouting her again—
Wait, huh? That's weird, they were just here a second ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pushing through the sea of people, I headed straight for the lush green turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of breath, I finally reached the winning post.
Aston Machan stood there with her usual smile.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Machan did wonderfully, didn't she?
Tada!
choice_data_list: I don't want people to forget you.
I don't want people to forget you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had fully intended to ask her, "I want to scout you."
Yet those were the words that spilled from my mouth instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had fully intended to ask her, "I want to scout you."
Yet those were the words that spilled from my mouth instead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ..."I don't want people to forget you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She couldn't possibly understand what I meant by that.
I panicked, knowing I needed to explain properly, but the right words wouldn't come.
choice_data_list: ...Watching your race made me realize something.
Watching that race made me realize...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood why she had said, "Please come watch."
It was backed by the supreme confidence that, on the racetrack, she could leave an impression deeper than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That race was intense enough to make me grasp that instantly.
It was burned so completely into my mind that it felt like it would never fade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, I didn't want it to ever fade.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “...Watching the race made you feel like you never want to forget me.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Hmm. Hmmm, indeed.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Pop quiz! Am I, Machan, clearly reflected in your eyes?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Are you truly, truly capturing me?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her heavy emphasis on the word struck a chord.
She definitely wasn't speaking in purely literal terms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desire was to leave a mark.
As widely and deeply as possible—across all of Japan, no, across the whole world.
choice_data_list: You're crystal clear in my sights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep capturing you, and I'll make sure everyone else's eyes capture you for all eternity, too.
I did my best to convey those feelings to her with every word I had.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “In everyone's eyes... for all eternity...”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “...Hehe, my, how lovely. I like that.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “It's decided. I shall make your eyes my very own personal camera lens.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Is that all right? It is, isn't it? Wonderful. Let us consider it settled.
And so... allow me to introduce myself properly once more.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “I'm Aston Machan.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan stepped gracefully into my field of vision.
So light on her feet, yet so ethereal. I stared intently, determined not to miss a single frame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “...Nice to meet you.”
